subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw replace its one-active-memory-plugin model with the proposed five public memory role slots and per-agent overrides, or should that composition remain outside the core contract until a narrower plugin API/RFC is approved?
rationale: This changes the permanent plugin/configuration taxonomy and conflicts with the current vision of one active memory slot converging on a recommended default; code review cannot determine the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed canonical role contract
options.body: Approve a named, minimal role taxonomy and require canonical runtime reads with Doctor-owned migration before the implementation is reconsidered.

options.title: Keep one memory owner
options.body: Retain the current single-slot product model and direct complementary memory behavior to existing plugin APIs or a separately approved extension seam.

options.title: Request an RFC first
options.body: Pause this implementation until an RFC specifies role semantics, third-party plugin compatibility, and the migration/removal plan for the legacy selector.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed canonical role contract
recommendation.body: Approve a named, minimal role taxonomy and require canonical runtime reads with Doctor-owned migration before the implementation is reconsidered.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership evidence connects this person to the memory runtime and plugin registry surfaces whose contract would change.
